title.rendered: Best Coupon Apps for iPhone and Android to Save Money

content.rendered:
Coupon apps make saving money easy and convenient. Find discounts, cashback, and deals directly on your phone for groceries, gas, food, and online shopping. This guide explains how coupon apps work and highlights the best options for iPhone and Android.

Table of Contents
  • What are Coupon Apps, and How Do They Work?
  • Criteria for Choosing the Best Coupon Apps
  • Best Coupon Apps for iOS and Android
    • 1. Flipp: Shop Grocery Deals App – Best for Grocery Shopping
    • 2. Dollar General – Digital Coupons – Best Store Coupon App
    • 3. KCL: Coupons, Deals, & Savings — Best for Shopping and Dining
    • 4. Groupon — Local Deals Near Me
    • 5. Coupon24: Coupons from Brands – Offline Savings
  • Tips to Maximize Your Savings with Coupon Apps
  • Are Coupon Apps Safe to Use?
  • Save While Shopping with Coupon Apps!

What are Coupon Apps, and How Do They Work?

Coupon apps collect discount offers, promo codes, and cashback deals from retailers and brands in one place. Instead of searching for discounts manually, they help you apply savings automatically or with minimal effort.

Most coupon apps work in one of three ways:

  • Clip-and-redeem coupons: Select coupons in the app and apply them when shopping online or in-store.
  • Receipt scanning: You upload a shopping receipt to earn cashback after purchase.
  • Automatic cashback: The app links to your card or browser and applies savings automatically.

And don’t confuse coupon apps with cashback apps. They’re slightly different. Coupon apps focus on instant discounts before checkout, whereas cashback apps, like Fetch, Rakuten, Upside, etc., reward you after you make a purchase.

Some apps combine both features.

Criteria for Choosing the Best Coupon Apps

Not all coupon apps are equally useful. The best ones make saving money simple and consistent.

Here’s what matters most.

  • Ease of Use: A good coupon app should make saving money easy. Look for apps with simple interfaces, automatic coupon application, and quick receipt scanning.
  • Cashback and Savings Potential: The best coupon apps will have frequent updates of new deals, savings by category, and bonus rewards or loyalty programs.
  • Retailer Partnerships: Apps that partner with grocery stores, gas stations, and e-commerce sites provide more available coupons, accurate cashback tracking, and better discounts.
  • Payment and Withdrawal Options: It should be easy to access your savings. Look for PayPal withdrawals, gift cards, direct bank transfers, and low payout thresholds.
  • Security and Reliability: Because some apps connect to payment methods or require receipts, security is a concern. Choose apps with strong app store ratings, secure login methods, and regular updates.

Best Coupon Apps for iOS and Android

Here are some of the most practical coupon apps people use daily.

1. Flipp: Shop Grocery Deals App – Best for Grocery Shopping

Flipp helps you find the best deals on groceries and everyday household items. Rather than having to flip through paper flyers, you can now view weekly ads, coupons, and store flyers digitally from thousands of retailers all in one place.

The app lets you search for specific products, compare prices across nearby stores, and create a smart shopping list that automatically shows relevant deals. You can also clip digital coupons, track price drops, and get notifications when items go on sale, making it easier to plan your shopping and save money.

Overall, Flipp works like a digital deal-finder and grocery-planning companion, helping you shop smarter and reduce your weekly shopping costs without juggling multiple store apps.

Download: iPhone | Android

2. Dollar General – Digital Coupons – Best Store Coupon App

The Dollar General app is simple and very effective if you shop there regularly. The marketplace has everything from groceries and cleaning items to school and office supplies. By joining the myDG® rewards program, you can access exclusive offers, cashback rewards, and weekly promotions at Dollar General stores.

The app lets you clip digital coupons and apply them automatically at checkout, browse weekly ads, create shopping lists, and track savings in one place. The best part is its cart calculator for budgeting and DG wallet to store coupons, rewards, and account information.

Download: iPhone | Android

3. KCL: Coupons, Deals, & Savings — Best for Shopping and Dining

KCL, short for The Krazy Coupon Lady, brings together exclusive coupons, discount tips, promo codes, and shopping hacks in one easy-to-browse place. Instead of figuring out complicated coupon strategies on your own and spending hours, it shows you step-by-step ways to save at popular stores.

You can explore daily deals, cashback offers, and limited-time discounts, and even learn simple couponing tricks that make everyday shopping more affordable. The app feels less like a traditional coupon tool and more like a friendly guide to cutting down on shopping costs and discovering savings opportunities with minimal effort.

Download: iPhone | Android

4. Groupon — Local Deals Near Me

Groupon focuses on experiences and local services in your area. Instead of paying full price, you can browse discounted offers and promo codes on restaurants, spa treatments, gyms, travel experiences, shopping deals, and local activities.

So, you can discover new experiences and hottest spots at lower prices, whether you’re planning a weekend outing, trying a new restaurant, or booking a service like a haircut or massage. Just purchase deals in the app and redeem them digitally at participating businesses. No hassle at all!

Download: iPhone | Android

5. Coupon24: Coupons from Brands – Offline Savings

Coupon24 aggregates brand coupons, promo codes, and special personalized offers for you. You can redeem multiple coupons in one scan, making it easier to save while shopping.

The highlight is that the app shows you nearby offline stores that accept coupons. So, browse through categories, explore trending offers, and quickly copy coupon codes when you’re ready to make a purchase.

Download: iPhone | Android

Tips to Maximize Your Savings with Coupon Apps

Using coupon apps occasionally saves money, but using them strategically saves much more.

Here are some smart habits:

  • Stack coupons with cashback whenever possible. Using a store coupon plus a cashback app often doubles savings.
  • Check multiple apps before shopping. Spending 30 seconds browsing offers before checkout can save a surprising amount.
  • Use grocery apps weekly. Grocery coupon apps provide the most consistent savings.
  • Turn on notifications. Many apps send alerts for limited-time deals.
  • Scan receipts immediately. Some cashback apps have time limits for receipt uploads.

Consistency matters more than chasing large discounts.

Are Coupon Apps Safe to Use?

Absolutely! Most popular coupon apps are safe to use. Apps that are available in the Apple App Store and Google Play Store have been checked for security.

However, you should take a few basic precautions:

  • Download apps only from official stores
  • Avoid sharing unnecessary personal information
  • Use strong passwords
  • Check reviews before installing new apps

Apps that link to payment methods typically use secure encryption, similar to that used by banking apps.

If an app offers unusually high rewards, it is best to steer clear.

Save While Shopping with Coupon Apps!

Coupon apps have emerged as one of the easiest ways to cut down on daily expenses without changing shopping habits. Whether you are purchasing groceries, gas, or eating out, the right apps can help you save money regularly.

I recommend using a grocery cashback app alongside a universal coupon app, a gas savings app, and a local deals app. Together, they can help you save money by turning small discounts into substantial savings on a monthly basis.

Which coupon apps do you use? Let me know in the comments below; I’ll give it a try!

title.rendered: Best USB-C Hubs for iPad You Can Buy

content.rendered:
With the latest iPadOS features, the iPad has become more powerful than ever. Whether you’re editing videos, attending online classes, working remotely, or gaming on a bigger screen, it can handle serious tasks. However, the iPad still has just one USB-C port.

That’s why a reliable USB-C hub is essential. It allows you to connect multiple devices at once, including an external monitor, keyboard, mouse, SSD, SD card, or even wired internet. This turns your iPad into a complete workstation without juggling adapters. In this guide, you’ll find the best USB-C hubs for iPad, along with tips on how to choose the right one and what mistakes to avoid.

What I Look for Before Buying a USB-C Hub for My iPad

The best USB-C hub really depends on how you use your iPad. Here’s what I look for before buying one:

  • Power Delivery (PD charging): Ensure the hub supports pass-through charging, ideally between 60W and 100W. This keeps your iPad charged while using accessories.
  • HDMI output resolution: If you plan to connect an external display, look for 4K at 60Hz. Some advanced hubs support even higher resolutions for newer iPad models.
  • Number of USB Ports: Think about what you plan to connect. A mouse, keyboard, external SSD, or USB microphone may require multiple ports. Choose based on your needs rather than maximum port count.
  • SD and microSD card slots: Important for photographers and video creators who regularly transfer media files.
  • Ethernet port: Provides stable internet for video calls, streaming, or gaming.
  • Build quality and heat management: Aluminum hubs generally offer better heat control and durability.

Best USB-C Hubs and Docks for iPad

Below are five of the best USB hubs and docking stations for iPad, iPad Pro, and iPad Air based on features, usability, and portability.

1. Anker PowerExpand USB-C Hub: Best for Professionals and Heavy Users

If reliability is your top priority, Anker remains one of the most trusted brands. The PowerExpand 8-in-1 USB-C Multiport Adapter is compact, heat-resistant, and widely compatible with iPad Pro, iPad Air, Mac, and Windows laptops.

You get:

  • 4K@60Hz HDMI output
  • 100W Power Delivery (up to 85W pass-through charging)
  • 2 USB-A 3.2 ports
  • 2 USB-C 3.2 data only port (10Gbps transfer speed)
  • SD and microSD card slots
  • Ethernet

It’s an excellent choice for creators and remote professionals who need a stable, long-term solution with strong build quality.

Check out on Amazon

Bonus

For desk workers, I recommend the Anker USB-C Hub with Table Stand. It’s foldable and designed exclusively for iPad. You get 8 ports, including HDMI, USB-A, SD card, and 3.5mm audio output, plus PD charging.

2. UGREEN Revodok Pro USB-C Hub: For Students and Gamers

The UGREEN Revodok Pro offers premium features at a mid-range price. It supports iPad Pro, iPad Air, Mac, and other USB-C devices. Its ultra-portable design makes it ideal for on-the-go use.

This 6-in-1 hub includes:

  • 4K@60Hz HDMI
  • 100W PD charging (85W output)
  • 2 USB-A 3.2 ports
  • 2 USB-C 3.2 ports (10Gbps speed)

If you want performance and affordability in one package, this hub strikes a solid balance.

Check out on Amazon

3. CalDigit E5: Thunderbolt Hub for iPad Pro Power Users

If you want to use your iPad Pro as a serious work device, the CalDigit E5 can transform it into a full desktop setup using a single cable. It supports up to 40Gbps Thunderbolt transfer speeds and 6K external display output. It also delivers up to 90W of power to keep your iPad charged.

You get 9 ports:

  • 4 Thunderbolt 5/USB4 v2
  • 3 USB-A 3.1
  • 2 USB-C 3.2 Gen 2 (10Gbps)

This hub is ideal for editors, designers, and professionals who require high-speed connectivity and advanced display support.

Check out on Amazon

4. Plugable 8-in-1 USB-C Hub with Stand: iPad Docking Station with Stand

The Plugable 8-in-1 USB-C hub allows you to seamlessly integrate your iPad into your workspace. It is lightweight and features a built-in stand, letting you position your iPad upright for work or media viewing.

The hub offers:

  • 4K@30Hz HDMI output
  • 100 W pass-through charging (Up to 91W delivery)
  • 2 USB-A 3.0 ports (5Gbps)
  • SD card and Micro SD card slots
  • 3.5mm audio jack

Keep in mind that the viewing angle is not adjustable, and HDMI output is limited to 30Hz.

Check out on Amazon

5. HyperDrive HD319B Docking Station: Best For Travel and Portability

If you prefer something sleek and compact, the HyperDrive HD319B attaches directly to your iPad’s USB-C port. Its slim design blends well with the iPad and keeps your setup minimal.

It includes:

  • 4K@60Hz HDMI
  • 5Gbps USB-C 60W Power Delivery
  • USB-A 3.0 (5Gbps)
  • SD and Micro SD slot
  • 3.5mm Audio Jack

It’s a practical choice for mobile professionals who need essential ports without carrying extra cables.

Check out on Amazon

Common Mistakes When Buying an iPad USB-C Hub

Many buyers overlook small details that later cause frustration:

  • Choosing a hub without Power Delivery support
  • Buying more ports than necessary, which increases cost
  • Settling for 4K at 30Hz when 60Hz is needed for smooth visuals
  • Not checking Thunderbolt compatibility for high-end iPads
  • Selecting ultra-cheap, unknown brands that may overheat or disconnect

Final Thoughts

In 2026, investing in the right USB-C hub is one of the smartest upgrades for your iPad. Instead of dealing with multiple adapters, you get a cleaner setup, improved workflow, and a more laptop-like experience.

  • For reliability, choose Anker PowerExpand.
  • For value, go with UGREEN Revodok Pro.
  • For advanced workflows, pick CalDigit E5.
  • For desk convenience, consider Plugable 8-in-1.
  • For portability, HyperDrive HD319B is a strong option.

Choose based on how you work, not just the number of ports.

FAQs

Can an iPad run dual monitors with a hub?

Yes, but it depends on the model. iPad Pro (M4, M2, M1) and iPad Air (M2, M1, and A16) models support extended external displays through Stage Manager. However, most USB-C hubs provide only one HDMI output. To run dual monitors, you need a specialized Thunderbolt dock instead of a basic hub.

Does a USB-C hub work with iPad Air?

Yes. The iPad Air is fully compatible with USB-C hubs. You can connect external displays, USB drives, keyboards, mice, Ethernet, and SD cards. Ensure the hub supports Power Delivery to keep your iPad charged while using accessories.

title.rendered: Image Playground Not Working on iPhone? 8 Fixes That Worked for Me

content.rendered:
Image Playground is part of Apple Intelligence, introduced with iOS 18. While it runs smoothly on supported iPhones, you might notice it missing, stuck during setup, or showing an “unavailable” error.

In most cases, this isn’t a hardware issue. The problem usually happens because Apple Intelligence hasn’t fully finished setting up, background downloads are incomplete, or your device doesn’t meet compatibility requirements. If you’re facing this issue, don’t worry – you’re in the right place. Below, you’ll find 8 proven fixes to get Image Playground working on your iPhone again.

Table of Contents
  • Why Image Playground is Not Working on iPhone
  • 1. Verify Device Compatibility
  • 2. Update to the Latest iOS Version
  • 3. Ensure Apple Intelligence is Enabled
  • 4. Check Device Language
  • 5. Force Quit the Image Playground App
  • 6. Try Using Image Playground Inside Supported Apps
  • 7. Restart Your iPhone
  • 8. Check the Provided Prompt
  • Signing Off…

Why Image Playground is Not Working on iPhone

Image Playground may stop working or fail to appear due to:

  • Unsupported iPhone model
  • Apple Intelligence setup still in progress
  • Region or language limitations
  • Background AI downloads are stuck
  • Outdated iOS version
  • Feature not fully installed yet

Identifying the cause helps resolve the issue faster.

1. Verify Device Compatibility

If Image Playground isn’t working on your iPhone, the first thing to check is whether your iPhone supports it. Image Playground is an AI feature and is only available on Apple Intelligence-supported devices. Here’s a list of all iPhones that support Apple Intelligence:

  • iPhone 15 Pro, 15 Pro Max
  • iPhone 16, 16 Plus, 16e
  • iPhone 15 Pro, 16 Pro Max
  • iPhone 17, 17 Pro, 17 Pro Max
  • iPhone Air

If you don’t own an iPhone on this list, you can not use Image Playground on it. However, if you have one but still can’t use the Image Playground app, we have other fixes.

2. Update to the Latest iOS Version

Apple introduced Image Playground alongside Apple Intelligence through incremental iOS updates. Early versions may not include all required components or stability improvements, leading to the feature malfunctioning or remaining hidden.

Installing the latest iOS version ensures your device receives updated AI frameworks, bug fixes, and feature activation updates delivered by Apple.

To update your iPhone, head to Settings → General → Software Update.

3. Ensure Apple Intelligence is Enabled

On newer iOS versions, Apple Intelligence is typically enabled automatically, but it can still be turned off manually or disabled after resetting settings. When Apple Intelligence is off, Image Playground and other AI tools stop functioning.

To verify:

  1. Open Settings.
  2. Tap Apple Intelligence & Siri.
  3. Make sure Apple Intelligence is turned on.

4. Check Device Language

Image Playground uses generative AI features that may be restricted by Screen Time or content controls. If restrictions are enabled, the app may fail to open, or certain options may be unavailable.

To check restrictions:

  1. Open Settings and tap Screen Time.
  2. Tap Content & Privacy Restrictions.
  3. Tap Intelligence & Siri.
  4. Select Image Creation under Apple Intelligence.
  5. Select Allow.

5. Force Quit the Image Playground App

Another way to fix Image Playground not working is to force-quit the app. Sometimes, when you access Image Playground in the standalone app, Messages, or Notes, a minor glitch may prevent it from functioning properly. In such cases, forcing a quit of the standalone app or the one you use to access Image Playground can often eliminate the glitch causing the trouble.

Here’s how:

  1. Swipe up and hold from the bottom center of the display to access the App Switcher.
  2. Here, swipe up on the Image Playground app to force quit it.

Once you’ve done this, reopen the app and check whether it is working normally; if not, move to the other solutions.

6. Try Using Image Playground Inside Supported Apps

Image Playground integrates directly with several Apple apps. If the standalone app behaves unexpectedly, testing it inside another app helps confirm that Apple Intelligence is functioning properly.

You can try it in:

  • Messages
  • Notes
  • Freeform
  • Keynote

If it works there, the issue is likely limited to the app interface rather than the feature itself.

7. Restart Your iPhone

A minor software issue or glitch can often cause certain apps and services to malfunction. If force-quitting the app doesn’t resolve the issue, you can try restarting the iPhone altogether. A simple restart can eliminate the minor temporary glitches that might be preventing Image Playground from working properly.

8. Check the Provided Prompt

There are multiple ways to create AI images in the Image Playground, such as via a text prompt. In most cases, Image Playground might fail to generate images from the given prompt and display an ‘Unable to use that description’ error. While you may think there is an issue with Image Playground, the issue lies with the provided text prompt.

This is because Apple has restricted prompts to prevent inappropriate images from being generated. You will receive the same error every time your prompt contains drugs, alcohol, murder, blood, death, or other controversial words.

Whenever you get the ‘Unable to use that description’ error, just remove the prompt and provide a new description, and Image Playground will handle the rest.

Signing Off…

And that’s it; these are the 8 ways you can fix the Image Playground not working issue on your iPhone. We hope you are able to resolve the issue and have started creating stunning AI images using Apple Intelligence. However, if you need further help, feel free to reach out to us via the comments.

Also read:

  • Genmoji not working on your iPhone? How to fix it
  • How to Fix RCS Messaging Not Working on iPhone
  • macOS Sequoia iPhone Mirroring not working? How to fix it

title.rendered: iPhone 18 Pro May Launch in New Deep Red Color

content.rendered:
The iPhone 18 Pro is still more than half a year away, yet early rumors about Apple’s next flagship colors are already gaining attention. The biggest highlight so far suggests Apple could finally introduce a red finish for a Pro-level iPhone, something users have long requested.

According to Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman, Apple is currently testing a new “deep red” color option for the iPhone 18 Pro lineup. The shift to an all-aluminum unibody design in the iPhone 17 Pro reportedly gives Apple greater flexibility to experiment with new finishes on its premium models.

Gurman notes that the existing Cosmic Orange color has proven highly popular, particularly in China. Because of that success, Apple may keep the orange option while adding red as an additional choice, even though the two shades sit close together on the color spectrum.

He adds that red is presently being tested internally as the flagship color for the next Pro models. Earlier rumors suggesting purple or brown finishes could simply be variations derived from this same red concept rather than entirely separate colors.

A red Pro iPhone would mark a notable shift for Apple. offered a red iPhone in the iPhone 14 series in 2022, and Pro models have historically avoided bold color options in favor of muted metallic tones.

iPhone Fold Expected to Avoid Bold Colors

Gurman also shared insights into Apple’s rumored foldable iPhone. Unlike the Pro lineup, the first-generation iPhone Fold may launch with conservative color choices.

Apple is expected to stick with classic finishes such as dark gray or black, alongside a lighter silver or white option. Limiting color variants could help simplify manufacturing for a completely new product category.

A similar strategy appeared with the iPhone X launch, which debuted in only two colors compared to the broader palette available on the iPhone 7 generation.

Apple is expected to unveil its next wave of iPhones in September, when the final color lineup should become clear.

Are you excited about a red Pro iPhone? Drop your thoughts in the comments.

excerpt.rendered: A new report suggests Apple is testing a deep red finish for the iPhone 18 Pro. If it launches, this would mark the first time a Pro model gets a bold red color, breaking away from the brand’s usual muted tones.

title.rendered: How to Mute Someone on Snapchat Without Blocking

content.rendered:
Snapchat is a great way to stay connected with friends, but sometimes the notifications can become overwhelming. Maybe someone sends too many messages, posts Stories all day, or keeps a group chat constantly active.

Rather than blocking or deleting them, you can mute them. It lets you eliminate distractions while staying in touch. In this guide, you’ll learn how to mute someone on Snapchat on both iPhone and Android, along with a few helpful tips to manage your notifications better.

Table of Contents
  • What Happens When You Mute Someone on Snapchat
  • Steps to Mute Someone in Snapchat on iPhone and Android
    • Turn Off Call and Chat Notifications (Including Group Chats)
    • Mute Someone’s Stories in Snapchat
    • Disable a Friend’s Location on Snapchat
  • Tips for Managing Snapchat Notifications
  • Keep Snapchat Notifications Under Control

What Happens When You Mute Someone on Snapchat

When you mute someone on Snapchat, they are not notified. Everything continues normally from their side.

They can still:

  • Send you Snaps
  • Send messages
  • Tag you in Stories
  • See your content (depending on your privacy settings)

The main difference is on your side. You stop receiving notifications or seeing their content prominently.

Unlike blocking or removing someone, muting helps you control your Snapchat experience without changing your friendships.

Steps to Mute Someone in Snapchat on iPhone and Android

The steps are similar on the iOS and Android app. Snapchat keeps these controls inside chat settings and friend profiles. Below are the different ways you can mute someone.

Turn Off Call and Chat Notifications (Including Group Chats)

If someone messages too often, you can silence notifications for that conversation.

  1. Open Snapchat.
  2. Go to the Chat tab.
  3. Press and hold the conversation you want to mute.
  4. Tap Chat and Notification Settings.
  5. Select Notifications Settings.
  6. Toggle on Mute Chats.
  7. Select a time limit, like For 1 hour or Four 8 hours or Until I unmute them.
  8. Then toggle on Mute Calls and set a time as well.
  9. Hit Done to confirm your choice.

A crossed bell icon will appear next to their name to show they’re muted. This works for individual chats and group chats. You’ll still receive messages, just without notifications.

For group chats, you can also enable notifications only for mentions and replies to your messages from Chat Notifications.

Mute Someone’s Stories in Snapchat

If a friend posts Stories too frequently, you can hide them without unfriending them.

  1. Launch Snapchat and move to the Chats section.
  2. Press and hold the friend’s chat.
  3. Tap Story Settings from the options.
  4. Toggle on Mute Story and tap Mute on the dialogue box.
  5. Keep the Story Notifications disabled.
  6. Tap Done to save it.

Their Stories will no longer appear at the top of your feed, but you can still view them manually if you want.

This method is useful when you want to fine-tune your Stories feed without removing anyone.

Disable a Friend’s Location on Snapchat

Snapchat’s Snap Map lets you see friends’ locations, but you can stop viewing location updates for specific friends.

  1. From Chats, long-press the friend’s chat.
  2. Tap Location Settings.
  3. Toggle on Mute [friend’s name] Location.
  4. Finally, hit Okay.

It prevents you from seeing your friend’s location updates.

Tips for Managing Snapchat Notifications

Muting people is just one way to make Snapchat less distracting. If you have a lot of active friends, group chats, and story updates, notifications can quickly become overwhelming. The good news is that you can control almost everything.

Here are a few extra tips:

  1. Turn off non-essential notifications by going to Snapchat profile > Settings (gear icon) > Notifications.
  2. Mute busy group chats instead of leaving them.
  3. Use Do Not Disturb mode on your phone when needed.
  4. Review notification settings regularly.
  5. Keep only important conversations unmuted.

These small changes can make Snapchat feel much calmer and easier to use.

Keep Snapchat Notifications Under Control

Muting someone on Snapchat is a simple way to reduce noise without damaging relationships. Whether it’s chat notifications, Stories, group conversations, location sharing, or game alerts, Snapchat gives you plenty of control.

The best part is that muting is private. The other person won’t know. You stay connected while keeping your notifications under control. For more tips and tricks, explore our other Snapchat guides.

FAQs

Can Someone Send You Snaps After You Mute Them?

Yes. Muting someone does not stop them from sending Snaps or messages. You simply won’t receive notifications for their activity. You can still open the chat and respond whenever you want.

Will They Know If I Mute Them on Snapchat?

No. Snapchat does not notify users when they are muted. From their perspective, everything works normally.

mainEntity.name: Can Someone Send You Snaps After You Mute Them?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Muting someone does not stop them from sending Snaps or messages. You simply won’t receive notifications for their activity. You can still open the chat and respond whenever you want.

mainEntity.name: Will They Know If I Mute Them on Snapchat?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Snapchat does not notify users when they are muted. From their perspective, everything works normally.

title.rendered: How to Delete Duplicate Photos on iPhone or iPad

content.rendered:
Duplicate images, similar photos, or accidental screenshots can quickly fill your storage and slow down your device. Thankfully, the Duplicates feature in the Photos app makes it easy to automatically detect and merge duplicate photos. In this guide, I’ll explain how to find and delete duplicate photos on your iPhone and iPad to free up storage.

Table of Contents
  • Does iPhone Automatically Detect Duplicate Photos?
  • Steps to Remove Duplicate Photos on iPhone or iPad
    • Alternative Method: Using Advanced Search
  • Steps to Remove Duplicate Photos on iPhone (iOS 15 or Earlier)
  • Best Apps to Remove Duplicate Photos on iPhone and iPad
    • 1: Clever Cleaner: AI Cleanup App
    • 2: Remo Duplicate Photos Remover
  • How to Prevent Duplicate Photos on iPhone in the Future
  • Conclusion

Does iPhone Automatically Detect Duplicate Photos?

Yes. The Photos app scans your library in the background and detects duplicate photos and videos. When duplicates are found, it creates a Duplicates album under Utilities.

However, it does not detect similar photos. These are different.

Duplicate photos are exact copies of the same image, such as saving an edited photo as a new file or importing the same photo twice. Similar photos, on the other hand, are different shots that look alike, such as the same pose taken multiple times, burst photos, or multiple screenshots of the same screen.

For example, if you take three photos of the same sunset, they are similar photos. But if your phone saves the exact same sunset photo twice, those are duplicates.

Steps to Remove Duplicate Photos on iPhone or iPad

If you are using iOS 16 or later, the built-in Duplicates feature in the Photos app makes finding duplicate images simple.

On iPhone:

  1. Open the Photos app.
  2. Go to the Collections and scroll down to Utilities.
  3. Tap Duplicates.
  4. Tap Select in the top right corner. You can select items individually or tap Select All.
  5. Tap Merge, then confirm by tapping Merge Items.

You can repeat the process or use Select > Select All > Merge for bulk cleanup.

When you merge duplicate photos, your iPhone keeps the highest-quality version, combines the metadata, and moves the extra copies to Recently Deleted.

On iPad (iPadOS 16 or later):

  1. Open the Photos app.
  2. Swipe from the left edge or tap the Show Sidebar button to open the sidebar.
  3. Under Utilities, tap Duplicates.
  4. Tap Merge, then tap Merge Exact Copies in the warning pop-up.

For batch removal, tap Select > Select All, then tap Merge.

Alternative Method: Using Advanced Search

You can also use the Advanced Search feature to find similar photos. It allows you to search by keyword, object, scene, location, or description, making it easier to spot image sets that look alike.

This method works the same on both iPhone and iPad.

  1. On iPad: Tap Search from the sidebar.
  2. On iPhone: Tap the Search tab at the bottom.
  3. Enter keywords such as:
    • “Selfies,” “Dogs,” “Cats,” “Beach,” “Documents,” or “Screenshots.”
    • Browse the results and review similar images.
  4. Select the photos you want to remove, then tap the Trash icon.

Advanced Search does not merge photos automatically, but it helps you quickly identify groups that are often mistaken for duplicates.

Steps to Remove Duplicate Photos on iPhone (iOS 15 or Earlier)

If your device is running an older version of iOS, follow these steps:

  1. Open the Photos app and go to Library or Albums.
  2. Tap Select in the upper right corner.
  3. Manually choose duplicate images.
  4. Tap the Trash icon, then confirm the deletion.

If you have large batches of screenshots, burst photos, or downloads, sort by Media Types to speed up cleanup.

Best Apps to Remove Duplicate Photos on iPhone and iPad

The built-in Duplicates feature only finds exact matches. It does not detect similar angles, near-identical shots, or burst images. For deeper cleaning, a third-party app can help.

1: Clever Cleaner: AI Cleanup App

Clever Cleaner is a completely free photo storage cleaner for iPhone and iPad. It has a clean interface and uses AI to scan your library and group duplicate photos. It also detects similar photos and displays them in a separate “Similars” tab. Features like Heavies help you remove or compress large files with a single tap.

Bottom Line: If you want a free, all-in-one app with no ads and a simple interface, Clever Cleaner is a solid choice.

Related: Best iPhone Cleaner Apps to Maximize Your Storage

2: Remo Duplicate Photos Remover

If you want something straightforward and easy to use, Remo Duplicate Photos Remover is a good option. With a single tap on Scan, it displays all duplicate images in two sections: Exact and Similar. You can preview the results and delete what you do not need.

Bottom Line: It effectively finds similar images and gives you full control over what gets deleted.

How to Prevent Duplicate Photos on iPhone in the Future

It is easier to prevent duplicates than to remove them later. Here are practical tips to keep your photo library organized:

  • Turn Off “Keep Normal Photo”: Your iPhone may save both an HDR and a normal version of a photo. Turning this off helps avoid duplicate-looking shots. Go to: Settings > Camera > Keep Normal Photo, then turn it off.
  • Avoid Reimporting the Same Photos: If you transfer photos from another device or computer, make sure you do not import the same batch twice. This is one of the most common causes of duplicates.
  • Use One Sync Method at a Time: Switching between iCloud Photos, AirDrop, or other transfer methods can create duplicate copies. Stick to one primary sync method.
  • Enable iCloud Photos on All Devices: When all your Apple devices use iCloud Photos, they stay in sync, which reduces mismatched versions and duplicate files.
  • Be Careful with Photo Editing Apps: Some apps save edits as new photos instead of updating the original. Use non-destructive editing apps when possible, or remember to delete older versions.
  • Clear Bursts and Screenshots Regularly: Burst photos, repeated takes, and screenshots add up quickly. Review and delete them weekly or monthly so they do not turn into clutter.

Conclusion

Cleaning up duplicate and similar photos on your iPhone or iPad does not have to feel overwhelming. With Apple’s built-in Duplicates feature, Advanced Search tools, and a few reliable third-party apps, you can reclaim storage and keep your photo library organized with minimal effort.

FAQs

Is It Safe to Merge Duplicate Photos?

Yes. Apple’s Merge function keeps the highest-quality file and combines the metadata. The discarded copies are moved to Recently Deleted, where they remain for 30 days before being permanently removed.

Will Deleting Duplicate Photos Free Up iCloud Storage?

Yes. If iCloud Photos is turned on, deleting duplicate photos and videos using the built-in Duplicates feature will free up iCloud storage space.

Will Third-Party Apps Offer Better Duplicate Detection?

Yes. Apple detects only exact duplicates. Third-party apps can also identify:

  • Live Photo variations
  • Similar photos
  • Screenshots
  • Blurry shots

These apps provide more advanced detection options for deeper cleanup.

mainEntity.name: Is It Safe to Merge Duplicate Photos?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Apple’s Merge function keeps the highest-quality file and combines the metadata. The discarded copies are moved to Recently Deleted, where they remain for 30 days before being permanently removed.

mainEntity.name: Will Deleting Duplicate Photos Free Up iCloud Storage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. If iCloud Photos is turned on, deleting duplicate photos and videos using the built-in Duplicates feature will free up iCloud storage space.

mainEntity.name: Will Third-Party Apps Offer Better Duplicate Detection?

@graph.name: How to find and delete duplicate photos on iPhone
@graph.description: Learn how to easily find and delete duplicate photos on your iPhone using the built-in Photos app to save storage space.

step.name: Open the Photos app
step.text: Open the Photos app on your iPhone or iPad to begin finding duplicate images.

itemListElement.text: Unlock your device and tap the Photos app.

step.name: Go to Albums
step.text: Go to the Albums tab and scroll down to the Utilities section.

itemListElement.text: Tap Albums at the bottom of the Photos app.
Scroll down until you see Utilities.

step.name: Access Duplicates
step.text: Tap Duplicates under Utilities to view all duplicate photos detected by your iPhone.

itemListElement.text: Select Duplicates to open the list of duplicate photos.

step.name: Merge duplicates individually
step.text: Preview the duplicates and tap Merge. Then tap Merge X Exact Copies to confirm merging photos.

itemListElement.text: Preview the duplicate photos.
Tap Merge to combine the duplicates.
Tap Merge X Exact Copies to confirm deletion of duplicates.

step.name: Merge multiple duplicates at once
step.text: If you want to merge multiple photos at once, tap Select in the top-right corner, then tap Select All, and finally tap Merge (X items). Confirm by tapping Merge X Exact Copies.

itemListElement.text: Tap Select in the top-right corner of the screen.
Tap Select All to highlight all duplicate photos.
Tap Merge (X items) at the bottom.
Confirm by tapping Merge X Exact Copies.

keyPoints.title: Tips to Prevent Duplicate Photos
keyPoints.explanation: Organize photos into albums, disable burst mode, delete original photos after editing, and turn off Auto HDR to avoid creating duplicates in the first place.

title.rendered: Rivian Launches Apple Watch App With Battery and Cabin Controls

content.rendered:
Rivian has released a dedicated Apple Watch app for its R1S and R1T electric vehicles, giving drivers direct access to core vehicle functions from their wrist. The update expands Rivian’s connected ecosystem and reduces the need to open the iPhone app for routine tasks.

Apple Watch App Adds One-Tap Vehicle Controls and Cabin Adjustments

The Apple Watch app supports up to four customizable one-tap controls. Drivers can lock or unlock doors, open or close windows, access the front or rear trunk, and trigger the vehicle alarm.

The app also enables cabin temperature adjustments and battery charging target changes using the Apple Watch’s Digital Crown. This allows drivers to fine-tune climate settings and charging limits remotely without pulling out their phone.

Rivian has added a watch face complication that displays the vehicle’s battery charge level. The information appears directly on the watch face, eliminating the need to open the app to check remaining range.

Also Read: Apple’s CarPlay Ultra Is Finally Expanding Beyond Luxury Cars

Apple Wallet Car Key Support Expands to Second-Generation Models

Rivian recently introduced Apple Wallet car key support for second-generation R1S and R1T models. The feature uses Ultra Wideband technology to enable passive entry.

With compatible devices, drivers can approach the vehicle, unlock it, and begin driving without removing their iPhone from their pocket or their Apple Watch from their wrist.

Passive entry requires an iPhone 11 or newer, excluding iPhone SE and iPhone 16e, and an Apple Watch Series 6 or newer.

For first-generation R1S and R1T models, digital key functionality remains more limited. Drivers can lock or unlock the vehicle from within the app, but full passive entry is not supported.

The Apple Watch app installs automatically after updating the Rivian iPhone app to the latest version from the App Store.

excerpt.rendered: Rivian’s new Apple Watch app lets R1S and R1T drivers check battery levels, adjust cabin temperature, and control key vehicle functions without using their phone.

title.rendered: 50+ Instagram Tips for iPhone: Use Instagram Like a Pro in 2026

content.rendered:
Instagram continues to introduce new features that make sharing your photos and videos easier than ever. Whether you’re a casual user, influencer, or business owner, knowing these Instagram features can help you stand out. Here, I’ll share expert tips, hidden tricks, and must-know settings to use Instagram on your iPhone like a pro. Good luck!

Table of Contents
  • 1. Restyle Your Stories with AI
  • 2. Automatic AI Dubbing & Lip-Syncing for Reels
  • 3. Auto Scroll Reels
  • 4. Enjoy a Personalized Feed with “Your Algorithm.”
  • 5. Repost Your Favorite Reels or Posts
  • 6. Track Your Friends with Instagram Maps
  • 7. Link Reels to Create a Mini Series
  • 8. Send HD Photos in DM
  • 9. Schedule a Direct Message
  • 4. Recover a deleted post, story, or reel
  • 5. See Who Has Unfollowed You
  • 7. Save the Instagram Story in the Highlights
  • 8. Find Out Who Viewed Your Instagram Highlights
  • 9. Praise Your Post Sharers
  • 10. Add Music Link to Your Instagram Bio
  • 11. Make Your Instagram Account Private
  • 12. Reduce Instagram Data Usage
  • 13. Hide Irrelevant Ads on Instagram
  • 14. Mute Someone's Stories
  • 15. Hide Inappropriate Comments on Posts
  • 16. Don't Save Original Photos on Instagram
  • 17. Pin Favorite Instagram Posts at the Top
  • 18. See the History of Your Instagram Account
  • 19. Clear Instagram Search History
  • 20. Save Instagram Stories as a Draft
  • 21. Find links You Have Visited
  • 22. Share Photos/Videos Directly to Instagram
  • 23. Restrict an Account on Instagram
  • 24. Archive Instagram Posts or Story
  • 25. Pause Instagram Push Notification
  • 26. Make a Close Friends List on Instagram
  • 27. Download Your Instagram Data
  • 28. Check Time Spent on Instagram
  • 29. Save Posts for Later on Instagram
  • 30. Add Another Instagram Account to the Bio
  • 31. Set Filters as Favorites
  • 32. Create an Auto-Complete Quick Reply
  • 33. Make Your Stories Interactive
  • 34. Get Notifications Whenever Your Favorite Person Posts
  • 35. Hide Photos You Are Tagged In
  • 36. Set Manual Tagging
  • 37. Turn Off Comments
  • 38. Go Quiet on Instagram
  • 39. Remove Instagram Followers
  • 40. Reset the Instagram Explore Page
  • 41. Hide Active Status
  • 42. Turn Off Your Precise Location
  • 43. Recover Your Instagram Account from Hackers
  • 44. Deactivate Your Instagram Account
  • 45. Change the Password of Your Account
  • 46. Hide Like Count on Instagram Post
  • 47. Share a Post as Your Story
  • 48. Hide the Story and Live with Specific People
  • 49. Auto-Generate Video Captions
  • 50. Change the Instagram Language
  • 51. Check Apps and Website Access to Your Account
  • 52. Share Your Instagram Profile
  • 53. Get Verified on Instagram
  • 54. Add Music to Instagram Notes
  • 55. Use Boomerang in Instagram

1. Restyle Your Stories with AI 

Instagram’s AI tools have made Stories much more creative and much easier. Now, instead of manually editing photos with multiple apps, you can use AI restyling options directly inside Instagram.

These tools can remove unwanted objects, automatically change backgrounds, and apply artistic filters to your photos.

To use Instagram Restyle Stories with Meta AI on iPhone:

  1. Open Instagram.
  2. Tap the plus icon on your profile picture to add a Story.
  3. Select a photo from your camera roll or take one.
  4. Tap the restyle button (pen icon) at the top.
  5. Now you can add, remove, or change any element in the photo by writing a prompt.
  6. Tap the Scroll through the preset filters for a quick edit.
  7. Once satisfied, post the story or save it on your device.

The key tip? Don’t overdo it. Clean, minimal edits perform better than overly filtered content. AI is there to enhance your story!

If you post Stories regularly, this feature saves time and keeps your content fresh.

2. Automatic AI Dubbing & Lip-Syncing for Reels 

Want to scale your content internationally with very little extra effort? This feature is a game-changer. Now, you don’t need to record multiple versions of the same video in different languages.

With Instagram’s AI-powered dubbing and lip-syncing for Reels, your videos are automatically translated into other languages. Meta AI keeps your voice tone and characteristics intact via cloning and syncs the lip movements for a natural look.

How to use it:

  1. Go to Instagram, tap the plus sign, and create or upload a Reel.
  2. Tap Next to go to the upload page.
  3. Write a caption and make all other necessary changes. Then scroll down and tap More options.
  4. Toggle on Translate reel under Accessibility and translation and select Allow translations.
  5. Now, tap translation settings and select your target language under Translate to.
  6. You may also toggle on Approve translations to review the dubbing before publishing.

Just upload the reel and let AI do its magic!

3. Auto Scroll Reels 

If you consume a lot of Reels, the Auto Scroll feature makes the binge experience smoother. Rather than swiping manually, Instagram can automatically move to the next Reel after one finish. It’s a small feature, but it improves usability and hands-free viewing.

To enable it:

  1. Open the Reels tab.
  2. Tap the three dots menu on the right side.
  3. Toggle on Auto scroll.

If you don’t see it yet, update your app. Instagram frequently rolls out features gradually.

4. Enjoy a Personalized Feed with “Your Algorithm.” 

Your Instagram feed is controlled by the Instagram algorithm. But most users don’t realize they can train it.

Here’s how to personalize your feed like a pro using Your Algorithm:

  1. Go to the Reels tab and tap the two lines and hearts icon in the top-right corner.
  2. You will see Your Algorithm page with a summary of the topics Instagram thinks you like.
  3. Here, type in which topic you want to see more and see less.

The more intentional you are, the better your feed becomes.

Take 10 minutes to clean your feed. Your daily scrolling experience will improve dramatically.

5. Repost Your Favorite Reels or Posts 

Instagram now makes it easier to repost public content. When you repost, your followers can see it on their feed. Also, there will be a dedicated Repost tab on your profile. So you can curate your favorite content with little effort.

  1. Open Instagram and tap the Repost icon next to the share button if available.
  2. To add your reaction, tap your profile picture bubble, enter text or emoji, and tap Save.
  3. Your followers can tap your bubble and send your direct message about your report.

6. Track Your Friends with Instagram Maps 

Want to stay updated with close friends? Instagram Maps lets you share your last active location with select friends and see where they’ve been posting.

  1. In Instagram, go to the Messages tab, swipe the Notes section, and tap Map.
  2. It will open your region’s map. Here, you will see the notes, posts, and stories of your friends at the location they have tagged.
  3. You can share your location by tapping Not sharing location at the top and selecting friends.

7. Link Reels to Create a Mini Series 

If you’re serious about content creation, this is a pro-level strategy. Instead of posting random Reels, you can create a mini-series by linking the reels. This will increase watch time, encourage profile visits, and build anticipation.

  1. Start posting a Reel and tap Link a reel under the caption section.
  2. Now, select an existing reel from your profile.
  3. You may add a title to your linked reel to make it more relevant and tap OK.
  4. Post the reel, and your followers can tap the linked reel under your caption to see it.

8. Send HD Photos in DM

Instagram now allows you to send high-quality (HD) photos in Direct Messages (DMs). So, you can easily share crisp, clear images with your friends, family, or clients. Previously, Instagram compressed images sent through DMs, reducing their quality. With this new feature, you can ensure that your photos look just as sharp as when you captured them.

Simply open Instagram and go to a friend’s or family member’s DM. Select a photo and tap the HD button before sending it. If you don’t see this option, update your Instagram app to the latest version. Finally, tap the send button.

This feature makes sharing photos on Instagram from your iPhone even more convenient, without the need for third-party apps!

9. Schedule a Direct Message

If you often miss sending important messages at the right time, this tip can be a lifesaver. You can schedule messages in Instagram DMs to ensure they are delivered at the right time, even when you’re offline.

To do so, type your message as you normally would in a DM. Now, instead of tapping the send button, press and hold it for a few seconds. A scheduling menu will pop up. Set your preferred date and time and tap the Send button below. Your message will now be sent automatically at the selected time.

4. Recover a deleted post, story, or reel

If, instead of archiving, you accidentally deleted an Instagram post, reel or story and regret doing so, you don’t need to worry at all. You can easily recover a deleted post or story in just a few taps. Here’s how:

  1. Head to your Instagram profile and tap the Hamburger icon at the top right.
  2. Now, tap Your Activity → Recently Deleted.
  3. Select the post you want to recover.
  4. Tap the Recover button.

5. See Who Has Unfollowed You

Are you wondering if someone has unfollowed you on Instagram? Unlike on other platforms, Instagram doesn’t notify you when someone unfollows you, but you can check manually or use third-party apps.

If you suspect someone has unfollowed you, you can check your Followers list on Instagram. If their name doesn’t appear, it means they are no longer following you.

However, checking specific users like this can be time-consuming. So, I suggest using Instagram followers checker tools such as FollowMeter, Reports+ for Followers Tracker, etc. Follow our detailed guide on how to see who unfollowed you on Instagram.

7. Save the Instagram Story in the Highlights

Instagram stories are a popular way to share daily moments with your followers, but they only last 24 hours before disappearing. If you want to showcase certain stories for an extended period, you can save them to your highlights.

Highlights are curated collections of stories you can display on your profile for as long as you like. So you can create a more permanent and organized way to showcase your content. To add a new highlight, go to your Instagram profile, tap the plus sign above your grid, select a past Story, enter your highlight name, and tap Done.

8. Find Out Who Viewed Your Instagram Highlights

As we mentioned above, Instagram highlights are a great way to keep your favorite Stories on your profile permanently. By default, you can see viewers for the first 48 hours after posting the original Story. After that, the list disappears, and only users who have reacted or engaged with your Story remain.

But have you ever wondered who is viewing your highlights after that? If the Story is older than 48 hours, you won’t be able to see new viewers. However, you can still track engagement using Follower insights for a business or creator account. Simply switch your account type from Instagram settings and select the professional account.

9. Praise Your Post Sharers

When someone shares your Instagram post, it means they found your content valuable, interesting, or entertaining. Acknowledging and appreciating these users can help strengthen your community, increase engagement, and encourage more people to share your posts.

However, Instagram does not directly show who shared your post, but there are ways to track it. If you have a creator account, you can check the post insights to see how many times your post was shared. Also, if someone has put a Story in your post, you will get a notification.

10. Add Music Link to Your Instagram Bio

Want to show off your music taste to your followers? You may add a track, album, or playlist link from any music streaming platform to your Instagram bio. Here, I will show you how to add a Spotify link.

  1. Go to Spotify → Open the song.
  2. Tap the share button → Select Copy link.

  3. Launch Instagram → Tap your profile icon at the bottom.
  4. Tap Edit profile → Select Links.
  5. Select Add external link.
  6. Now, paste the music link in the URL section and write a title.
  7. Once finished, tap Done.

Once a text is edited, both the sender and receiver will see the Edited mentioned below the message bubble.

11. Make Your Instagram Account Private

Don’t want unknown people to see your pics? You need to enable Private Account, which allows you to approve people before they can follow you. It doesn’t apply to your existing followers.

  1. Open Instagram → Select the profile icon to go to the profile tab → Tap the hamburger icon.
  2. Tap Account Privacy.
  3. Toggle on Private account → Select Switch to Private. 

12. Reduce Instagram Data Usage

If you have poor network coverage or are short on data, this feature will help. However, it will hamper your experience as the media will take time to load.

  1. Open Instagram → Select the profile icon to go to the profile tab → Tap the hamburger icon.
  2. Tap Media quality.
  3. Toggle on Use less cellular data.

13. Hide Irrelevant Ads on Instagram

Instagram ads are increasing daily, but they can become irritating when they’re irrelevant. So, you may hide them. If the feed got refreshed, you may find recently viewed ads on Instagram.

  1. Tap the three dots icon on an ad post.
  2. Select Not interested → Then choose a reason.

14. Mute Someone’s Stories

While you enjoy watching stories from your friends and favorite influencers, there may be times when you want to mute specific stories without unfollowing the user. Perhaps the content is irrelevant to you, or you just need a break from seeing their updates. 

Whatever the reason, you can refer to our guide on muting stories on Instagram to tailor your feed to your preferences. So, you can enjoy the content you love without feeling overwhelmed by the content you don’t.

15. Hide Inappropriate Comments on Posts

After posting something, you’ve probably encountered a comment you wish to remove or hide. Fortunately, Instagram provides an easy way to hide inappropriate comments. So you can take control of the conversation and maintain a positive environment on your profile. 

  1. Open Instagram → Select the profile icon to go to the profile tab → Tap the hamburger icon.
  2. Select Hidden Words.
  3. Toggle on Hide comments.

You may also add custom words and phrases that you don’t want in your comment box or message requests from Manage custom words and phrases. Then, toggle on Hide comments under that.

16. Don’t Save Original Photos on Instagram

Instagram filters are great. But whenever you post an image, it automatically saves a copy in your gallery. So, your storage may run out quickly. 

  1. Go to Instagram Settings.
  2. Tap Archiving and downloading.
  3. Toggle off Save original photos.

17. Pin Favorite Instagram Posts at the Top  

You can customize your profile in several ways but I most love the pinned posts. You can pin three posts at the top of your feed.  

  1. Open the Instagram post you want to feature. 
  2. Tap the three-dots icon. 
  3. Select Pin to your profile. 

18. See the History of Your Instagram Account

Do you want to know when you joined Instagram and your former usernames or bio texts? Well, you can know all these in easy steps:

  1. Tap the hamburger menu → Your activity.
  2. Select Account history.
  3. Here, you can see a list of all the information. Tap the activity to see the full details.

19. Clear Instagram Search History

You can clear your Instagram search history and remove all traces of what accounts you searched for. To do this:

  1. Launch Instagram and tap the Search icon.
  2. Tap the Search bar → Select See All.
  3. Select Clear All and tap Clear All again to confirm.

20. Save Instagram Stories as a Draft

Sometimes you may not have enough time to post a photo or video immediately, or you may want to edit it before sharing it. In these cases, you can save your half-finished post as a draft on Instagram. So, you can quickly come back to it later and finish your edits or add captions without losing your progress. Note that the Story drafts will expire in the next seven days.

  1. Open Instagram and swipe left to right to open the camera.
  2. Click a photo or record a video.
  3. Tap Close icon (x).
  4. Select Save Draft.

You must like to read: What are multiple captions in Instagram carousel posts?

21. Find links You Have Visited 

Do you visit websites linked to Instagram posts? The app now records all your link visits so you can return to them anytime. 

  1. Select the profile icon to go to the profile tab → Tap the hamburger icon.
  2. Go to Your activity. 
  1. Select Link history. 
  1. Here, you can see your link history. 

  2. To delete the list, tap Clear all → Clear.

22. Share Photos/Videos Directly to Instagram

Rather than searching through your camera roll while posting, you may directly share photos or videos on Instagram from the Photos app. So, you can quickly and easily share your favorite moments with your followers as feed posts/Stories or send them via DM.

23. Restrict an Account on Instagram

Have you encountered an account that makes you feel uncomfortable or harassed? In these situations, you may use Instagram’s “Restrict” feature to limit an account’s interaction with your profile without blocking them.

So, whether you’re dealing with cyberbullying, harassment, or unwanted attention, restricting an account on Instagram can help you take control of your social media experience and protect yourself.

Must read: Instagram Restrict vs. Block: Which should you choose?

24. Archive Instagram Posts or Story

Sometimes, you may want to remove a post or story from your profile feed without deleting it. This is where the “Archive” feature comes in handy. Archiving allows you to hide a post or story from your profile rather than removing it. So you can view archived posts later or restore them to your profile if you change your mind. 

Also, Instagram Stories disappear after 24 hours, but you can keep them saved if you archive them. Therefore, archive Instagram posts or stories on your iPhone to easily manage your content and keep your profile looking its best. Later, you may also delete archived stories permanently. 

25. Pause Instagram Push Notification

Getting too many notifications can be annoying, but you can change the notification frequency.

  1. Go to Instagram Settings.
  2. Tap Notifications.

  3. Choose the setting that suits your needs. 
  4. Toggle on Pause all to stop push notifications for a selected period.

26. Make a Close Friends List on Instagram

You may add some people as your close friends. This allows you to share stories that are not for everyone, but only close friends. No one can see your close friend list except you. To add a friend as a Close Friend:

  1. Go to a friend’s profile and tap Following.
  2. Select Add to Close Friends List.
  3. Further, to see all your close friends, go to your Instagram profile and tap on the hamburger icon.
  4. Now tap Close Friends.
  5. You can see your list or quickly add multiple people as close friends from the Suggestions list here.

27. Download Your Instagram Data

If you use Instagram for business or marketing purposes, it’s crucial to have access to your Instagram data. So, Meta lets you download your Instagram data, including photos, videos, messages, and more. This can be a valuable tool for backing up your content or gaining insights into your online presence.

28. Check Time Spent on Instagram

Are you spending too much time on Instagram? Well, you can see the activity time and make adjustments.

  1. Go to Instagram Settings → Time management.
  2. Here, you can see the time you spent on Instagram.

You may also set a daily time limit that will notify you once you reach the time duration. Further, you may enable Sleep mode, which will mute notifications for the time you set.

29. Save Posts for Later on Instagram

Whenever you come across any insightful posts, you may save them. Just tap the bookmark icon on the post. Also, you may create collections to organize saved posts on Instagram. 

30. Add Another Instagram Account to the Bio

If you have another account for professional works or a business account, you may promote that on your primary account. 

  1. Tap the profile icon to go to your profile tab → Select Edit profile.
  2. Tap Bio.
  3. After your bio text, type @ and enter your Instagram ID.

To optimize your bio further, add relevant hashtags (#). 

Also, you may add links to your Facebook profile, LinkedIn, or website by tapping Links.

31. Set Filters as Favorites

Instagram offers the best filters and effects for capturing stories and reels. But it can be frustrating to search through different filters and find your favorite one each time. How about saving filters for quick access? 

  1. Open the camera on Instagram.
  2. Scroll through the filters at the bottom.
  3. Tap the bookmark icon.

  4. You may also delete a filter. For that, tap it and select Remove effect → Remove.

32. Create an Auto-Complete Quick Reply

Want to save time replying to direct messages? You can set up automated quick replies on Instagram. The feature is available on professional accounts.

  1. Open the Instagram app → Tap the messenger icon. 
  2. Tap the three-dots icon → Tools.

  3. Select the Saved reply.
  4. Tap the plus icon and enter your shortcut according to the auto-complete message.
  5. Choose Save.

33. Make Your Stories Interactive

You can easily engage with your followers through Instagram Stories stickers. Let them ask you questions, vote on polls, answer quizzes, etc.  

  1. Select a photo or video from the gallery or capture one for your Story.
  2. Tap Sticker icon.
  3. Choose Poll, Quiz, Questions, or anything as per your choice.

34. Get Notifications Whenever Your Favorite Person Posts

With so much content being shared on Instagram daily, it’s easy to miss posts from those we care about. So, if you don’t want to miss out on any updates from your favorite person on Instagram, you can get notifications whenever they post. To stay up to date with the latest content from someone you admire,

  1. Open Instagram → go to their profile.
  2. Tap the bell icon.
  3. Toggle on Stories.

You may enable notifications for Stories, Reels, Videos, and Lives. 

35. Hide Photos You Are Tagged In

Suppose someone tags you in a post that shows on your profile. So, you may untag yourself from inappropriate posts.

  1. Go to your Instagram profile.
  2. Tap the tagged icon.
  3. Choose the post to open it → Tap the three-dots icon.

  4. Tag Options.
  5. Select Remove me from post.

You may choose Hide from my profile if you don’t want to untag yourself.

36. Set Manual Tagging

I know checking tagged posts and deleting each one is tedious. So, you may turn on manual tagging. Whenever someone tags you in their posts, you need to approve them. After that, it will show up on your profile.

  1. Open your profile on Instagram.
  2. Tap the tagged icon.
  3. Choose any post.
  4. Tap Manage.

  5. Tap the three-dots icon → Manage settings.
  6. Toggle on Manually approve tags.
  7. Select Turn on to confirm.

You may approve posts from Pending Tags.

37. Turn Off Comments

Sometimes, social media trolling gets on your nerves. What should you do then? Delete the post or report each comment? Instead, I suggest turning off comments on Instagram. It will disable the comment box and help you take control of it. 

38. Go Quiet on Instagram

If you are too distracted by Instagram notifications, you may enable Quiet mode on Instagram. It helps you to focus on yourself by pausing notifications and messages.

39. Remove Instagram Followers

It may sound weird, but there may be instances when you want to remove a follower. There are two ways to remove Instagram followers and make you stress-free.  

40. Reset the Instagram Explore Page

The Instagram Explore page helps you find trending posts that are relevant to you. But sometimes, the Instagram algorithm messes up and shows irrelevant posts. In this case, it’s best to reset the Instagram Explore page. 

41. Hide Active Status

Do you want to scroll through your feed without letting others know? The trick is to disable active status on Instagram.

42. Turn Off Your Precise Location

Do you know you must turn off your precise location on Instagram? It will protect your identity and save you against multiple threats.

43. Recover Your Instagram Account from Hackers

The worst-case scenario is if your account is hacked. But don’t panic! You may recover your hacked Instagram account. 

44. Deactivate Your Instagram Account

If you want to take a break from Instagram, you may deactivate it rather than delete it. Because once you delete your account, you can’t recover it. So, learn how to deactivate your Instagram account.  

45. Change the Password of Your Account

Most of us forget our Instagram account credentials. But what if you get locked out and can’t enter the correct password? You may easily reset your Instagram password and log in again.

46. Hide Like Count on Instagram Post 

Instagram offers a way to hide the like count so no one can see it, except that you can see the details, including the total number and engaged accounts. 

  1. Open the post. 
  2. Tap the three-dots icon → Hide like count.
  3. To see the like count, tap View count under the post. 

47. Share a Post as Your Story 

Have you come across an interesting post and wanted to share it with your followers? You can do this by following: 

  1. Tap the Share icon on the posts. 
  2.  Select Add to story.

You can share the post via Messenger, WhatsApp, Twitter, Facebook, Snapchat, etc. Also, you may copy the link to that post if necessary.  

48. Hide the Story and Live with Specific People 

Instagram lets you adjust the privacy settings for your story and Live videos.   

  1. Go to Settings. 
  2. Select Hide story and live and tap it again.

  1. Search for the users you want to hide from. 
  1. Tap Done.

49. Auto-Generate Video Captions

When I forget my AirPods at home while on the go, this feature is lifesaving. It auto-generates captions for IGTV videos and Reels, and you can enjoy them without sound.

  1. Open Settings → Accessibility and translations → Captions and translations.

  1. Select Always show closed captions.

50. Change the Instagram Language  

Indeed, it will be fun to use your favorite app in your native language. 

  1. Open Settings → Language. 
  2. Tap Continue.

  3. It will redirect you to your iPhone settings.
  4. Tap Language.
  5. Choose your preferred language.

51. Check Apps and Website Access to Your Account 

Sometimes, I use my Insta ID to sign up for apps and websites to save time. So, when I can’t remember credentials, I check the Instagram app access. Also, granting account details access to shady websites is not safe. So, if you have granted Instagram ID permissions to any apps or websites, check and remove that.  

  1. Navigate to Settings → App website permissions → Apps and websites. 
  2. Here, you will see the app lists with active authorization.  

You may also check the apps and websites for which the authentication has expired or for which you have removed access. 

52. Share Your Instagram Profile 

Want a hack to share your Insta account without typing your ID? Follow the steps below: 

  1. Go to your Instagram profile → Tap Share profile. 
  2. Now, show your friend the QR code. 

You may also select Share profile or Copy link to share your Insta ID. Additionally, you can create QR codes for your posts, too. 

  1. Open the post and tap the three-dots icon. 
  2. Select QR code. 
  3. Tap Save to Camera Roll. 

53. Get Verified on Instagram 

A verification badge is a sign of trustworthiness that helps followers to connect with you. But how to get it? Only professional accounts are eligible for this. A verification badge is a sign of trustworthiness that helps followers connect with you. But how to get it? Only professional accounts are eligible for this.  

  1. Open Settings → Creator tools and controls. 
  2. Tap Request verification. 
  3. Fill out the form and tap Submit.

54. Add Music to Instagram Notes

With the latest updates rolled out almost every day, here’s another one that will change how you use the Notes feature on Instagram.

Users can now share their favorite music in Instagram Notes. Follow the steps prescribed below to try it out for yourself:

  1. Launch Instagram → Access the DMs section.
  2. Tap Your Note option and hit the Music icon.
    You can share thoughts the traditional way if you desire.

  3. Search for your favorite artist or album, like you normally do.
  4. Choose a segment from the song and tap Done.
  5. Hit Share to conclude the process.

55. Use Boomerang in Instagram

The Boomerang feature lets you take a short burst of photos that cycle back and forth to create looping videos or GIFs. You can capture a quick moment or create fun, engaging content to grab your audience’s attention. So, whether you’re a seasoned Instagram user or just getting started, you must know how to use Boomerang on Instagram.

Rock on, Instagram stars!

I hope this extensive guide provided you with useful pointers. But that’s not all! Our website has many more tips and tricks for using Instagram on iPhone. If you are getting started with Instagram Reels, Avatar, or Notes, we have guides for each. So, you may explore those and find answers to your Instagram problems.

mainEntity.name: Is It Safe to Merge Duplicate Photos?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Apple’s Merge function keeps the highest-quality file and combines the metadata. The discarded copies are moved to Recently Deleted, where they remain for 30 days before being permanently removed.

mainEntity.name: Will Deleting Duplicate Photos Free Up iCloud Storage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. If iCloud Photos is turned on, deleting duplicate photos and videos using the built-in Duplicates feature will free up iCloud storage space.

mainEntity.name: Will Third-Party Apps Offer Better Duplicate Detection?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Apple detects only exact duplicates. Third-party apps can also identify: Live Photo variations Similar photos Screenshots Blurry shots These apps provide more advanced detection options for deeper cleanup.

title.rendered: How to Hide App Store Purchases on iPhone, iPad, and Mac

content.rendered:
Purchased an app or subscription, but don’t want it to appear in your App Store history? I have been there too. After all, we often make private purchases we don’t want others to see, especially when we share them with family members. In this article, I’ll show you how to hide apps from your App Store purchase history on iPhone, iPad, and Mac.

Table of Contents
  • Hide Purchases from App Store on iPhone, iPad, or Mac
    • On iPhone or iPad
    • On Mac
  • How to Unhide App Store Purchases on iPhone, iPad, or Mac
    • On iPhone or iPad
    • On Mac
  • What Happens When You Hide an App in Your App Store Purchase List
  • Prevent and Protect!

Hide Purchases from App Store on iPhone, iPad, or Mac

The steps to hide purchases on iPhone and Mac are quite straightforward. I have detailed them below:

On iPhone or iPad

  1. Open the App Store on your iPhone.
  2. Tap your profile icon in the top-right corner.
  3. Here, tap Apps.
  4. Locate the app you want to hide.
  5. Swipe left on the app and tap the Hide button that appears.

On Mac

  1. Launch the App Store app on your Mac → Click the profile icon at the bottom left.
  2. Hover over the app of your choice and click the three-dot icon next to it.
  3. Select the Hide Purchase option.
  4. Finally, click Hide Purchase to complete the process.

How to Unhide App Store Purchases on iPhone, iPad, or Mac

Now, in case you have changed your mind and want to find the hidden purchase on the App Store, do the following:

On iPhone or iPad

  1. Launch the App Store → Tap the profile icon.
  2. Select your Apple ID.
  3. If prompted, enter the password of your account.
  4. Upon verification, scroll down to Hidden Purchases under DOWNLOADS AND PURCHASES.
    You’ll be able to access every hidden purchase in one place.
  5. Simply hit Unhide next to the app, and you’re good to go.

On Mac

  1. Go to App Store → Profile icon → Account Settings.
  2. Sign in to your Apple Account if asked.
  3. Click Hidden Purchase in the pop-up menu.
  4. Now, click the Manage option in the Hidden Items section.
  5. Click the Unhide button next to the app you want to unhide.

What Happens When You Hide an App in Your App Store Purchase List

When you hide an app from your App Store purchase list, Apple simply removes that app from your visible purchase history without deleting it or affecting your access to it. The app will no longer appear in the Purchased section of the App Store, helping keep certain downloads private or reduce clutter in your list.

If you use Family Sharing, the hidden app also becomes invisible to family members in shared purchases. However, hiding an app does not uninstall the app from your iPhone or iPad, cancel its subscriptions, or erase associated data.

You still own the app and can download it again at any time by searching for it directly in the App Store. This feature only changes how the app appears in your purchase history, not how it functions on your device or your Apple account.

Prevent and Protect!

I hope you have now learnt how to hide dating apps, VPNs, or other purchases you have made on the App Store.

Do you have any further queries regarding the App Store? If yes, do share them in the comments below. I’ll respond ASAP!

  • How to cancel downloads and updates from Mac App Store
  • How to get i3-like tiling windows on Mac with AeroSpace

mainEntity.name: Is It Safe to Merge Duplicate Photos?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Apple’s Merge function keeps the highest-quality file and combines the metadata. The discarded copies are moved to Recently Deleted, where they remain for 30 days before being permanently removed.

mainEntity.name: Will Deleting Duplicate Photos Free Up iCloud Storage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. If iCloud Photos is turned on, deleting duplicate photos and videos using the built-in Duplicates feature will free up iCloud storage space.

mainEntity.name: Will Third-Party Apps Offer Better Duplicate Detection?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Apple detects only exact duplicates. Third-party apps can also identify: Live Photo variations Similar photos Screenshots Blurry shots These apps provide more advanced detection options for deeper cleanup.

aioseo_head_json.author_bio:
Vikhyat has a bachelor’s degree in Electronic and Communication Engineering and over five years of writing experience. His passion for technology and Apple products led him to the tech writing space, where he specializes in writing App features, How-to guides, and troubleshooting guides for fellow Apple users. 

 

About Vikhyat Rishi

  • Vikhyat has over five years of experience writing consumer tech content.
  • During his association with Smartprix and Beebom, Vikhyat has tested, tested, and reviewed numerous gadgets, including but not limited to smartphones, TVs, and more.
  • His passion for technology and Apple products led him to iGeeksBlog, where he specializes in writing How-to and troubleshooting guides for fellow Apple enthusiasts.

Experience

Vikhyat embarked on his journey in consumer technology writing in 2019, driven by his passion for technology. He has sharpened his skills through associations with Smartprix and Beebom, where he extensively tested and reviewed various gadgets, focusing mainly on smartphones. Currently, Vikhyat specializes in crafting How-to and troubleshooting guides for the Apple ecosystem at iGeeksBlog. When not typing away on his MacBook Air, he loves exploring the real world.

title.rendered: WhatsApp Introduces Group Message History for New Members

content.rendered:
WhatsApp has announced the rollout of a new feature called Group Message History, designed to help new members quickly catch up on conversations after joining a group chat. Meta says the feature has been one of the platform’s most requested additions.

The update addresses a common problem: new members joining active groups without enough context to follow ongoing conversations. With Group Message History, users adding someone to a group will now see an option to share recent messages with the new member.

How Group Message History Works

According to WhatsApp’s blog post, groups can choose to send between 25 and 100 recent messages, allowing newcomers to view relevant conversation history without needing to scroll through everything. The shared messages appear separately from regular chat messages and include timestamps and sender information for clarity.

WhatsApp notes that message history is not shared automatically. Instead, it must be manually selected when adding a new participant. The platform will also notify everyone in the group when message history has been shared to maintain transparency.

Admin Controls Included

Admins also have additional control, with the option to disable Group Message History entirely for groups that involve sensitive discussions.

More Group Chat Updates

The feature follows last month’s rollout of several other group chat updates, including member tags, text stickers, and event reminders, as WhatsApp continues expanding tools focused on improving group communication.

What are your thoughts on WhatsApp’s new Group Message History feature? Let us know in the comments.
